# agyn_tunnel_credential (Resource)

Manages an Agyn private network tunnel credential.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) Private network identifier.

### Read-Only

- `connectivity` (String) Tunnel connectivity state.
- `enrolled_at` (String) Enrollment completion time in RFC3339 format.
- `enrollment_jwt` (String, Sensitive) One-time OpenZiti enrollment JWT. The API only returns this during creation.
- `enrollment_jwt_expires_at` (String) Enrollment JWT expiration time in RFC3339 format.
- `enrollment_jwt_revealed` (Boolean) Whether the enrollment JWT has been revealed.
- `enrollment_state` (String) Tunnel enrollment state.
- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the tunnel credential.
- `last_seen_at` (String) Last observed tunnel connection time in RFC3339 format.
- `provisioning_state` (String) OpenZiti provisioning state.
